name: Bizotic Commercial Ltd
about:
Incorporated in 2016, Bizotic Commercial Ltd 
 is in the business of trading of fabric material 
 and garments[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1][2]
BCL is in the business of manufacturing, designing, and marketing Ready-made garments under the brand name Urban United which is a men’s apparel brands. Company offers a fashionable range of menswear garments in its exclusive brand outlets. It does trading of men’s readymade garments and fabrics on wholesale and retail basis

pros: Company has delivered good profit growth of 93.0% CAGR over last 5 years
Debtor days have improved from 120 to 79.8 days.
cons: Stock is trading at 11.1 times its book value
Though the company is reporting repeated profits, it is not paying out dividend
Company has a low return on equity of 10.8% over last 3 years.
